mapper.select: insert into content.report_issue (id, period, start_date, end_date, volume, headline, lead, story_count, event_count, source_count, official_source_count, featured_count, estimated_minutes, generation_metadata) values (#{id}, #{period}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{volume}, #{headline}, #{lead}, #{storyCount}, #{eventCount}, #{sourceCount}, #{officialSourceCount}, #{featuredCount}, #{estimatedMinutes}, '{"generator":"M6_RULE_BASED","version":"1"}'::jsonb) on conflict (period, start_date) do update set end_date=excluded.end_date, volume=excluded.volume, headline=excluded.headline, lead=excluded.lead, story_count=excluded.story_count, event_count=excluded.event_count, source_count=excluded.source_count, official_source_count=excluded.official_source_count, featured_count=excluded.featured_count, estimated_minutes=excluded.estimated_minutes, status='DRAFT', published_at=null, published_by=null, generated_at=now(), updated_at=now(), version=content.report_issue.version+1 returning id::text
mapper.insert: insert into content.report_section (id, report_issue_id, section_code, title, sort_order) values (#{id}, #{issueId}, #{code}, #{title}, #{sortOrder})
insert into content.report_item (id, report_section_id, content_item_id, position) values (#{id}, #{sectionId}, #{contentId}, #{position})
mapper.select: select id, period, start_date, end_date, volume, headline, lead, status, story_count, event_count, source_count, official_source_count, featured_count, estimated_minutes, version, generated_at, published_at, published_by, updated_at from content.report_issue order by start_date desc, period, id desc limit #{limit}

select id, period, start_date, end_date, volume, headline, lead, status, story_count, event_count, source_count, official_source_count, featured_count, estimated_minutes, version, generated_at, published_at, published_by, updated_at from content.report_issue where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update content.report_issue set headline=#{headline}, lead=#{lead}, version=version+1, updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and status='DRAFT'
update content.report_issue set status='PUBLISHED', published_at=now(), published_by=#{actorId}, version=version+1, updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and status='DRAFT'
